## Wanda Mines

The Wanda mines are located in Misiones Province, Argentina. The departure city and transfer arrangements are agreed at booking.

The Wanda mines were established in 1994. Around that time, when the area was farmland, an 'unusual' stone was found and sent for examination. It turned out to be a gemstone, marking the beginning of a mining operation that continues to this day. The open-pit mines and tunnels now form part of a visitor route for those wishing to discover this site. In addition to the mining tunnels, the complex has a shop selling precious and semiprecious stones and jewellery, as well as a restaurant on the grounds. In a spacious open area, accompanied by bilingual guides, visitors can spend around 1 hour exploring and admiring the geological formations in the mines. On arrival, they will see the open workings, where the various gemstones seem to grow out of the ground. The site also contains numerous tunnels approximately 2 metres high and 4 metres wide, some reaching depths of up to 25 metres. The walls of the tunnels show the effects of lava and oxygen over many years, giving rise to stones that are both a popular tourist attraction and widely used in jewellery and decorative items sold locally by Argentinians. Throughout the visit, guides explain the formation, extraction and cutting of the stones. Visitors encounter several types of gemstones, including: • amethyst; • jasper; • quartz; • agate; • topaz.

## Price

Price: $160.

## Belo Horizonte and Minas Gerais

Belo Horizonte offers a glimpse of Brazil away from its ocean beaches. The capital of Minas Gerais is known for its urban architecture, cultural venues and local cuisine. Wide streets and squares stand alongside neighbourhoods where you can observe everyday life: small shops, meetings in cafés and conversations in the street.

Two of the city's best-known landmarks are associated with Praça da Liberdade and Pampulha. Buildings from different architectural periods survive around the square, while Pampulha is known for the lakeside ensemble created with the involvement of Oscar Niemeyer. Together, they reveal how varied Belo Horizonte can be. The specific places visited depend on the city-tour route.

This sightseeing tour is a good way to get your first impression of the city and decide what you would like to explore further afterwards. Both grand architectural forms and small details of daily life are worth noticing. Belo Horizonte is particularly appealing to travellers interested in the cities and culture of inland Brazil.

## Excursion terms

The excursion costs $200 per person.

Discounts may be available for more than one person; contact us to discuss.

## Asunción on the Paraguay River

Notable landmarks include López Palace, one of the symbols of the capital. The Costanera waterfront offers a different perspective on the city, with open space, water and panoramic views of the riverside neighbourhoods. These places help convey the character of Asunción, but the specific stops and building visits depend on the agreed city-tour itinerary.

A sightseeing excursion is a good introduction to Paraguay and its capital. The city is especially interesting for those who enjoy observing everyday life as well as monuments: shop signs, conversations and the movement of the streets. Bring a hat and comfortable shoes for the walk.

## Excursion terms

The price is per person. Discounts may be available for more than one person; contact us to discuss.

The excursion begins in Soberanía National Park, one of Panama's protected rainforest areas. Here you can discover the wildlife and birdlife of the region.

At the Panama Rainforest Discovery Center, the walk continues along forest trails. You then climb the observation tower to see the surrounding forest and green canopy in the Panama Canal basin.

The next part of the route takes place in Gamboa, where the Chagres River meets the Panama Canal. Here you learn about the forest ecosystem and its role in the canal's operation. Wildlife watching takes place in a natural setting; sightings of particular animals cannot be guaranteed in advance.
